crewNotes.text: General Türkiye traveller allowances; crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with the Ministry of Trade. Compiled from the cited guidance, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Per passenger: 1 litre of spirits over 22% alcohol, or 2 litres of alcoholic drinks at 22% or below.

declarationRequirements.text: Accompanied baggage goods up to EUR 430 in value (EUR 150 for under-15s) are exempt; higher-value goods are taxed or must be declared.

rules.text: Per passenger: 600 cigarettes, plus 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars, and 250g of pipe/shredded tobacco.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.

sources.authorityName: Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Trade
